svg.title: From Renewal Signal to Retained Operator Revenue
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-authorized-renewal-to-retained-fees; chart type: process_flow; title: From Renewal Signal to Retained Operator Revenue; subtitle: Five operating stages separate employer claim dollars from earned fees.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Employer authorization, appropriate producer licenses, service agreements, and claims-access controls precede account-level work. The expected first-deal window is 2–5 months.; caption: The desk sells documented analysis and execution. Employer claim funds, premiums, rebate principal, and premium refunds remain outside operator revenue except for the contractual earned fee.; stages: label: Research the renewal; value: Form 5500 account intelligence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Search DOL EFAST2 filings and available Schedules A/C for employer, broker, and service-provider signals. Confirm renewal timing and self-funded status directly rather than assuming every stop-loss policy appears in public filings.; label: Authorize the engagement; value: Licenses, scope, and compensation; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Verify state Life & Health and Property & Casualty authority for the actual activities. Deliver covered ERISA section 408(b)(2) disclosures and execute employer authorization, fee terms, and applicable HIPAA agreements.; label: Reconcile the evidence; value: PBM, stop-loss, and E-Mod analysis; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Normalize claims and contracts; compare NADAC with matched NDC quantities and dispensing fees. Reconcile rebate eligibility, payroll classes, loss runs, and rating worksheets before labeling a difference recoverable.; label: Implement the correction; value: Written terms and accountable owners; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Document specific and aggregate stop-loss attachments, lasers, run-out coverage, and reference-based-pricing balance-bill defense. Submit supported rating corrections through the carrier or applicable bureau process.; label: Recognize retained fees; value: Earned service revenue only; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Invoice PEPM services, reconcile retained commissions, and recognize contingent splits when contractual earning conditions and applicable variable-consideration criteria are satisfied. Track cash collection separately.

circle.title: label: Research the renewal; value: Form 5500 account intelligence; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Search DOL EFAST2 filings and available Schedules A/C for employer, broker, and service-provider signals. Confirm renewal timing and self-funded status directly rather than assuming every stop-loss policy appears in public filings.

text.title: Search DOL EFAST2 filings and available Schedules A/C for employer, broker, and service-provider signals. Confirm renewal timing and self-funded status directly rather than assuming every stop-loss policy appears in public filings.

circle.title: label: Authorize the engagement; value: Licenses, scope, and compensation; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Verify state Life & Health and Property & Casualty authority for the actual activities. Deliver covered ERISA section 408(b)(2) disclosures and execute employer authorization, fee terms, and applicable HIPAA agreements.

text.title: Verify state Life & Health and Property & Casualty authority for the actual activities. Deliver covered ERISA section 408(b)(2) disclosures and execute employer authorization, fee terms, and applicable HIPAA agreements.

circle.title: label: Reconcile the evidence; value: PBM, stop-loss, and E-Mod analysis; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Normalize claims and contracts; compare NADAC with matched NDC quantities and dispensing fees. Reconcile rebate eligibility, payroll classes, loss runs, and rating worksheets before labeling a difference recoverable.

text.title: Normalize claims and contracts; compare NADAC with matched NDC quantities and dispensing fees. Reconcile rebate eligibility, payroll classes, loss runs, and rating worksheets before labeling a difference recoverable.

circle.title: label: Implement the correction; value: Written terms and accountable owners; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Document specific and aggregate stop-loss attachments, lasers, run-out coverage, and reference-based-pricing balance-bill defense. Submit supported rating corrections through the carrier or applicable bureau process.

text.title: Document specific and aggregate stop-loss attachments, lasers, run-out coverage, and reference-based-pricing balance-bill defense. Submit supported rating corrections through the carrier or applicable bureau process.

circle.title: label: Recognize retained fees; value: Earned service revenue only; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Invoice PEPM services, reconcile retained commissions, and recognize contingent splits when contractual earning conditions and applicable variable-consideration criteria are satisfied. Track cash collection separately.

text.title: Invoice PEPM services, reconcile retained commissions, and recognize contingent splits when contractual earning conditions and applicable variable-consideration criteria are satisfied. Track cash collection separately.
Assumptions: Employer authorization, appropriate producer licenses, service agreements, and claims-access controls precede account-level work. The expected first-deal window is 2–5 months.
